# Alka Traders — Company and Sourcing Profile

## About Alka Traders

Alka Traders is a marine and industrial equipment supplier based in Bhavnagar, Gujarat, India. The company has supplied marine spares and industrial equipment since 1990 and works with manufacturers, distributors, surplus suppliers, and logistics partners to source current-production and hard-to-find parts.

Head office:

PLOT - 7 ALANG HOUSE, MOTITALAV ROAD, KHUMBHARWADA, BHAVNAGAR-364001, GUJARAT, INDIA

## What Alka Traders supplies

Alka Traders focuses on procurement rather than manufacturing. The catalog and quotation process cover:

- Marine spare parts, ship spares, and engine room equipment
- Marine pumps, separators, filters, and heat-exchange components
- Hydraulic pumps, motors, valves, cylinders, and power units
- Pneumatic valves, cylinders, and air preparation equipment
- Electrical automation, variable-speed drives, PLCs, contactors, breakers, and instrumentation
- Navigation, communication, and bridge equipment spares
- Deck machinery, mooring, rigging, lifting, and safety equipment
- Surplus, refurbished, discontinued, and obsolete industrial equipment

Specific brands, models, conditions, prices, and stock levels depend on the live catalog and supplier confirmation. The website does not guarantee that every brand or part family is in stock at a given time.

## Industries served

- Marine shipping and fleet management
- Shipyards, drydocks, and repair facilities
- Oil and gas, including offshore operations
- Power generation
- Manufacturing and industrial MRO
- Chemical processing
- Shipbuilding and heavy engineering
- Mining and material handling

## Brand coverage

Brand coverage varies by requirement and available stock. The brand directory includes major industrial and marine manufacturers such as ABB, Siemens, Parker Hannifin, Bosch Rexroth, Schneider Electric, Danfoss, Honeywell, Emerson, Festo, SMC, SKF, and IFM, among others. Always confirm the exact manufacturer and part number in the quotation.

## How procurement works

1. Search the catalog for a listed part, or open the request-for-quote form.
2. Send the manufacturer, model, part number, quantity, destination, and any nameplate or serial plate photos.
3. Alka Traders checks supplier availability and confirms the part identity, condition, price, and expected dispatch window.
4. The buyer approves the quotation and the order proceeds with the agreed payment, packing, and shipping method.

For urgent requirements, use the phone or WhatsApp contact details so the request can be triaged outside normal desk hours.

## Indexing notes

Only English storefront pages are indexed. Product URLs follow `https://alkatraders.co/en/product/{slug}/`. Eligible brand and category hubs are indexed only when they contain substantive editorial copy and at least one published product. Search results, checkout, order tracking, password flows, account pages, and administrative routes are private and noindex.
